references.label: Side drop-target banks
references.description: Left and right banks whose completions reset and advance the Combination.

references.label: Upper award lanes
references.description: Top lanes that collect Extra Ball or Double Bonus after Combination step one.

references.label: Captive-ball shots
references.description: Two captive balls worth 50,000 at step one and used for Extra Ball or Double Bonus at step two.

references.label: Lower Special lane
references.description: Lower lane that collects Special after Combination step three.

references.label: End-of-ball Bonus
references.description: Bonus advanced by each drop target and paid at 10,000 per step before any lit multiplier.
